horses.spotlight_comment: 5f(AW) For 3yo+ Weights 3yo 9st 8lbs; 4yo+ 10st 4lbs Weight for age 3 from 4yo 10lb Penalty value 1st £€8,835 2nd £€2,835 3rd £€1,335 4th £€585 5th £€285 6th £€135 STAND Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Beach Barbie 4 9-13 E Lynam James Ryan 20-1 - - 58 Footstepsinthesand filly out of Magic Bear, a 5f/6f winner (including at this track) for the stable; didn't do anything to suggest she's ready to win a maiden when sixth of seven here 14 days ago (beaten 8l), albeit very green; down in trip; should come on for that but likely not enough to threaten. She's A Gift 4 9-13 J McConnell Siobhan Rutledge (3) 50-1 39 - 44 13-race maiden, six of those coming at this track; best effort when fourth over C&D in handicap off a basement mark in January; little chance of winning a maiden. Call The Cavalry 3 9-8p C Timmons Gary Carroll 12-1 71 - 72 Ran to a similar level first two starts when fifth and second over C&D; improved stepped up to 7f when beaten 3l into fifth by Glitter And Glory 34 days ago; trip likely too sharp but each-way claims. Eager Lad 3 9-8 A Oliver Chris Hayes 10-1 - - - 15,000euros yearling; Mehmas colt; half-brother to winners Geometrical (Group-placed 7.5f/1m Flat inc 2yo, RPR 103; 2m hurdle) and Slaney Tide (1m2f; 71); dam unraced half-sister to smart 1m/1m2f winner King's Gambit, out of sister to 1m Group 1 winner Sophisticat; trip sharp on pedigree. Namiid 3 9-8 J Murtagh Seamie Heffernan 2-1 86 - 81 Eight-race maiden who ran to a consistent level last year; best effort came when beaten 4l into third behind Ipanema Queen in Listed race at the Curragh in August; bit below form when a beaten fav' at Naas 217 days ago but raced keenly on ground softer than ideal; gelded; surface should suit and sets a good standard. Atallah 3 9-3 K Clarke Gavin Ryan 66-1 - - 34 Hasn't shown much to get excited in two starts, not beating a rival either occasion, including at this track 13 days ago; down in trip; unlikely to figure. Aughlish 3 9-3 Ms C O'Connell Declan McDonogh 6-1 - - 80 Showed ability when fourth on debut here in February and improved markedly on that when beaten 1.5l by Allsortz 13 days ago; showed pace that day so drop in trip should be fine; big player with more improvement to come, albeit tricky draw. Falcon Queen 3 9-3h K Condon W J Lee 8-1 - - 72 Too keen over 7f here on debut in December when a well-held fourth; improved a bit dropped in trip in a hood after a break 22 days ago when beaten 4.25l by Ocean's Breath; drops in trip; should step forward again but needs to. Frosted Sky 3 9-3 D McLoughlin Scott McCullagh 15-2 - - - No Nay Never filly; dam Listed-placed 6f winner (RPR 98), half-sister to winners Violet's Lads (7f-1m2f) and The Big Bad (6f 2yo), out of German/Belgian 7f-1m1f winner; trainer can ready them; market check. Real Encounter 3 9-3 Mrs J Harrington Shane Foley 11-4 80 69 84 Ran to a similar level when fourth at Leopardstown (6f) and here (7f) last year, form of latter looking particularly strong now; returned with a neck second to Allsortz 13 days ago (Aughlish 1.25l back in third) here over 6f; drops in trip; should improve for last run and likely to go very close.

While Namiid leads the way on ratings and should be tough to beat, it's worth siding with the Jessica Harrington-trained REAL ENCOUNTER, particularly as she has race-fitness on her side. She had two good runs last year and the form of her fourth in September is working out well. She should have the pace to cope with 5f and they mightn't be able to get to her if she gets out in front. Aughlish wasn't far behind her last time and should also be on the premises. [Conor Fennelly] Page 1 spotlightdundalk 23.04.26

5f(AW) For 3yo (70 = 9st 12lbs) Weights raised 3lb Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€7,068 2nd £€2,268 3rd £€1,068 4th £€468 5th £€228 6th £€108 STAND Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Stone Bear 3 9-12 R O'Sullivan Siobhan Rutledge (3) 11-4 67 - 71 Two-time course winner in a good vein of form; landed 6f handicap here in January; too free when seventh over 7f after; back to winning ways over 6f 22 days ago, beating Bullet Bourbon by 1.75l, travelling powerfully; drop to 5f shouldn't be a problem; leading player off 7lb higher albeit drawn wide. Baby Basma 3 9-10 E J O'Neill Colin Keane 6-1 65 - 71 Won a 5f Cork maiden on debut in April 2025, form of which nothing special; returned from nearly a year off the track 41 days ago, ran ok to be beaten 9.5l into fourth by Flanker Jet; will improve for that and opening mark looks quite fair. Plushy 3 9-9 G Cromwell Gary Carroll 100-30 64 56 70 Bounced back to form of her maiden runs when 1.75l second to Stone Bear here over 6f in January; followed that up 15 days later with a third over the same C&D; 13lb better off with Stone Bear than when they last met; likes to be ridden forcefully and dangerous back in trip for trainer in flying form. Love Bomb 3 9-7v W McCreery W J Lee 16-1 62 - 70 Showed ability last year in maidens and scored on handicap debut over 5f at Down Royal; ran ok on seasonal debut at Naas before finishing 11th of 13 here over 6f 22 days ago, 6l behind winner Stone Bear; drop back to 5f will suit and could run well. Subiaco 3 9-6 K Cotter Leigh Roche 15-2 61 - 66 C&D winner on handicap debut in January, beating subsequent winner An Laochmor by 1.5l; backed that up off 7lb higher when beaten under 2l into fourth next time over same C&D; below form on turf last time out but ground an obvious excuse; chance. Hooves Your Daddy 3 9-4 J Fahey Ronan Whelan 25-1 59 - 69 Best effort in six starts came by some way when fifth in Naas maiden in August (6f, good); beat one rival home in two handicap starts since; off 206 days; dropped 4lb but needs revival. Luminessa 3 9-2t1 J Davison James Ryan 8-1 57 - 67 Fair form in trio of maidens, latest when beaten 3.25l into fifth by Oxford Circus 55 days ago; travelled nicely that day so drop back to 5f looks a good move; opening mark doesn't look harsh; definite chance in first-time tongue-tie. Gosford Queen 3 9-0 D J Murphy Shane Foley 14-1 55 - 67 Ran a reasonably promising race amid greenness when a 5l fifth over C&D on second start in December; below that last time out over 7f when well-held in ninth, too keen upped in trip; fair opening mark based on second run and could be an improver after 132 days off. Lady Landhort 3 8-12 M Fahey Reese Holohan (7) 14-1 53 - 68 Improved to spring 33-1 surprise when beating Jazzy Dancer by 0.5l over 6f here last month; ran fine when beaten 4.5l into eighth off 4lb higher 22 days ago; drops in trip and has a squeak under good claimer. Boston Max 3 8-8t1 G Elliott Chris Hayes 8-1 49 - 57 Well-held in three maidens last year, sent off at three-figure prices the last twice; not much to recommend him on so far but starts in handicaps off low mark for top trainer; drops in trip; first-time tongue-tie; off 201 days and gelded.

competitive affair in which Stone Bear ought to be popular given the drop back to 5f should be no problem after she travelled powerfully on her way to a victory at this course earlier this month. However, LUMINESSA also travelled eyecatchingly last time over 6f before flattening out into fifth. She's an interesting handicap debutante off a very fair opening mark and could offer some value. Plushy should be thereabouts too, while any market support for Boston Max on handicap debut should be taken very seriously. [Conor Fennelly] Page 2 spotlightdundalk 23.04.26

1m(AW) For 3yo rated 0-60 Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€5,900 2nd £€1,900 3rd £€900 4th £€400 5th £€200 6th £€100 STAND Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Caoilte 3 9-12 D Marnane Luke McAteer 17-2 60 52 61 Made decent debut over C&D in January, below that form twice in maidens after; beaten 4.75l on handicap debut here over 7f 13 days ago, finished off okay having been outpaced; step up in trip will suit; each-way claims. Brave Approach 3 9-5 J Fahey Ronan Whelan 18-1 53 - 63 Showed little in three maidens before making a winning handicap debut over C&D last month, staying on well to beat Kc Bear by 0.75l; well placed that day and form of that questionable; failed to back it up when well beaten 34 days ago; not one of the obvious ones. Queen Leila 3 9-4t N Kelly Shane B Kelly 7-1 52 65 68 Encouraging second over 7f here in January; below form in two subseqeunt starts; well-backed and fared better ridden more positively 13 days ago when beaten 2.75l into fourth by Royal County Glory; on an okay mark but step up to 1m not guaranteed to suit. Elora Prince 3 9-2b K Cotter Nicola Burns (5) 9-1 50 - 60 Nursery form on turf left a lot to be desired last year but ran much better upped to this trip when beaten 4.5l into fourth by Keepsgettingbetter last month over C&D; poor run again on turf 12 days ago in first-time blinkers; can bounce back on the AW and an each-way contender. Cause I Like You 3 9-1t M Mulvany Declan McDonogh 11-2 49 - 67 Couple of fair runs in maidens at this track over 5f/6f; poor run on soft ground at Naas last month but fared better back on the AW 22 days ago over 6f, staying on into fifth, beaten 3l by Stone Bear; on a good mark and this trip could unlock improvement. Beau Army 3 9-0 A McGuinness Adam Caffrey 13-2 48 - 64 Dual course winner over 6f/7f last year (beat Queen Leila and Iryna's Star in January); curbed by increase in rating last twice on AW, finishing sixth both occasions; underwhelming run on turf 15 days ago but soft ground an obvious excuse; steps up in trip and can be thereabouts. Keskon 3 9-0 N Kelly Rory Cleary 18-1 48 - 62 Nothing of note in maidens, or on handicap debut over C&D in December; ran better after a break when beaten 3l into seventh over 6f here 41 days ago; back up in trip; hard to fancy. Push Harder 3 8-13h C Timmons Wayne Lordan 7-2 47 - 64 Caught the eye when staying on into fifth over C&D on handicap debut in first-time hood in November; backed that up next time when beaten 2.75l into third by John La Bear; dropped 2lb; off 141 days; one of the more solid options. Iryna's Star 3 8-10t M Mulvany Wesley Joyce (3) 10-1 44 68 71 Best effort in ten starts came here over 7f on second handicap start when beaten 2.75l into third by Beau Army (Queen Leila in second); poor in five starts since but mark has dropped accordingly and step back up in trip should help. Wedding Year 3 8-8t A McGuinness Chris Hayes 9-1 42 - 58 Showed next to nothing in three turf maidens and a nursery but improved switched to AW over 7f last twice; beaten 4l into fourth by Beau Army 83 days ago; should stay a mile.

race that's hard to make much sense of due to plenty of muddling formlines. Push Harder is probably the most solid proposition given she's run two encouraging races over C&D, but IRYNA'S STAR could be well treated back at this venue. She didn't enjoy 5f or soft ground the last twice and is 11lb lower than when third behind Beau Army and Queen Leila in January. Cause I Like You and Elora Prince are also ones for the shortlist. [Conor Fennelly] Page 3 spotlightdundalk 23.04.26

1m(AW) For 4yo+ rated 0-60 Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€5,900 2nd £€1,900 3rd £€900 4th £€400 5th £€200 6th £€100 STAND Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Comfort Line 9 10-2v A McGuinness Cillian Rowan (10) 5-2 60 52 62 Six-time course winner with his last win coming over 7f here in March last year off 72; modest 3-71 strike-rate on turf but excellent third of 20 over 1m at Leopardstown 11 days ago, headed in closing stages; big player in current mood under 10lb claimer. Rampage 7 10-2tv T McCourt James Ryan 10-1 60 - 64 Four-time winner, including on turf early in his career; won over C&D from current mark during a busy 2025 campaign; three runs on turf this year, a few lengths off Comfort Line when eighth of 20 at Leopardstown 11 days ago. Imperial Fighter 7 9-12tv1 P McKenna Patrick McGettigan (5) 25-1 56 - 64 Two minor wins on Flat in Britain; failed to build on C&D second in January; best of six subsequent runs when fourth in C&D claimer; well beaten here (7f) on latest; new headgear is tried now. Roman Harry 6 9-12p S Duffy N G McCullagh 15-2 56 57 65 Gained just second win from 39 starts when springing 50-1 shock in 7f course claimer in December; creditable efforts in two handicaps here since for new yard; below best on softish ground at Leopardstown eight days ago but player back on this surface. Sonoma Sunset 4 9-10p1 W Farrell Colin Keane 20-1 54 - 47 Weak maiden form; big price when failing to make any impression at the Curragh on handicap debut; tailed off on AW debut in November but was drawn wide on first try at 10.5f; returns from break with Colin Keane booked so market must be monitored; cheekpieces. Famous Enough 6 9-8t P Foley Luke McAteer 11-1 52 - 64 C&D winner in September from 7lb lower; got going too late when beaten favourite at Cork end of last term; slowly away and eased once chance was gone on return at Gowran a fortnight ago; should be sharper now. Mullacash Buzz 8 9-5t T Dowling Jack Cleary (5) 20-1 49 - 57 Six-time winner (four on AW) but last win came here in 2023; never a factor in either course outing this year. Cosmic Force 4 9-0 K Clarke Adam Caffrey 7-2 44 - 62 Maiden after 15 starts; placed only twice, including on latest when never-nearer third of 12 here (7f) 13 days ago; each-way player if he sees out the extra furlong from unchanged mark. Desert Of The Sea 5 8-11p T McCourt Sadhbh Tormey (7) 11-1 41 - 63 Second runner for yard; cheap purchase out of Ed Bethell's yard; has found his level since coming down from a peak Irish rating of 56; runner-up over 7f here in January before hitting the frame twice over C&D; faded late after forceful ride from wide draw on latest; player from inside draw. Bang Po 6 8-10b L McAteer Shane Foley 50-1 40 - 63 Heavy-ground winner in September 2023 but no joy since; has struggled in two Dundalk runs this year; 5lb wrong. Master Garvey 6 8-10t J Murray Declan McDonogh 9-2 40 - 64 Has done a lot of racing since C&D win off 47 just over a year ago, one of only two wins in 48-race career; solid third in C&D handicap earlier this month; raced keenly from wide draw at Gowran on latest; contender at his best.

With a staggering 112 runs under his belt, COMFORT LINE (nap) clearly thrives on his racing and will be difficult to beat with a reproduction of his Leopardstown run 11 days ago. Cosmic Force should lay down a strong challenge if he sees out the extra furlong, while Desert Of The Sea is a solid option for the each-way players. [Adrian Wall] Page 4 spotlightdundalk 23.04.26

91), Popeye Doyle (1m/8.6f AW; 76) and Catalyzed (US 8.5f turf); dam French 6f-1m winner (inc 2yo/Listed; 100), half-sister to French 6f-9.5f winner Red Crazy; in good hands and trainer in form. Druids Glen 3 9-8p1 A P O'Brien Wayne Lordan 5-2 - - 72 Frankel colt, brother to yard's top-class Irish 1,000 Guineas winner Lake Victoria; very green on debut at Leopardstown in October when fifth; small step forward when 12l sixth to James J Braddock on heavy 172 days ago, still green; steps up in trip in first-time cheekpieces; another step forward likely and obvious claims. Mendez 3 9-8 C Timmons Nathan Crosse 4-1 - 61 76 Promising debut when 3.5l fourth here over 1m 48 days ago behind Son Of Beauty, despite being unconsidered in market; not given a hard time and will improve; steps up in trip and should be thereabouts. Sir Trancealot 3 9-8 J Murtagh Seamie Heffernan 14-1 - - 43 Raced freely before fading on heavy ground at the Curragh 26 days ago, finishing last of ten; should be capable of better but big step forward required. I Hope You Dance 3 9-3 H De Bromhead W J Lee 11-2 - - 75 Showed ability when eighth on racecourse debut at Cork in September; matched that form when beaten 15.5l behind potentially smart rival 187 days ago; form of that maiden looks strong; can figure if handling step up in trip.

1m4f(AW) For 3yo Weights 9st 8lbs Penalty value 1st £€10,013 2nd £€3,213 3rd £€1,513 4th £€663 5th £€323 6th £€153 STAND Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Bay Of Stars 3 9-8 D Weld Colin Keane 7-1 - - 63 Well-bred Irish Derby entry ran to just a fair level when beaten 10l over 1m here 153 days ago; looked in need of experience and should improve plenty, but needs to upped in distance. Bell Ex Too 3 9-8 R Cody Donagh O'Connor 14-1 - - 72 Nice pedigree and fared okay in what looked a strong maiden on debut on soft at the Curragh 26 days ago, beaten 17.5l into sixth; improvement likely up in trip and not discounted. Changing Lanes 3 9-8 J P O'Brien Declan McDonogh 3-1 - - - 125,000euros yearling; Galiway colt; half-brother to winners Rising Up (French 6.5f-1m inc AW;

brother to the top-class Lake Victoria, DRUIDS GLEN has looked raw in two starts but has run to a decent level and there could be plenty of improvement in him away from testing ground stepped up in trip. Mendez shaped well when fourth in a mile maiden here last month and can be on the premises with more improvement. I Hope You Dance and newcomer Changing Lanes also make appeal. [Conor Fennelly] Page 5 spotlightdundalk 23.04.26

1m4f(AW) For 3yo+ (90 = 10st) Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€11,780 2nd £€3,780 3rd £€1,780 4th £€780 5th £€380 6th £€180 STAND Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Mont St Michel 5 10-3tp1 D Hogan Jared Huggan (10) 14-1 93 - 93 By Galileo; 2m1f Killarney win last summer; out of depth in Group 2 Prix Foy and well below best on final start for Aidan O'Brien; fair run when thrown in at the deep end for hurdles/stable debut at Leopardstown; struggled at Thurles; AW/handicap debut; new headgear. Hollys Graces 4 9-12 H De Bromhead W J Lee 16-1 88 - 92 Lightly raced 4yo won 7f course maiden on debut in September 2024; well held in four runs last year in good-class company; return to AW could spark a revival on handicap debut but it will need to. San Andreas 10 9-9 J P O'Brien Shay Wallace (7) 15-2 85 61 93 Course regular (8-35) who is now at the veteran stage; no faulting his two runner-up efforts over 1m4f/2m here this year; always behind in valuable 1m2f Lingfield contest at Easter; solid claims back at his favoured venue. Beauparc 6 9-6t G Keane Colin Keane 3-1 82 - 92 Dual C&D winner, gaining fourth career win here last month off 75, plenty to spare when beating Voice Of Reason; good effort when third from this mark in follow-up bid; Colin Keane takes over now; shortlisted. Voice Of Reason 6 9-6 W Delahunty Julian Pietropaolo (7) 7-1 82 86 94 Winner on turf and over hurdles; has developed into a capable AW performer, notching three wins and four seconds from nine runs here; no match for Beauparc last two outings; not guaranteed to avenge defeat despite booking of 7lb claimer. Drucker 4 9-3 A Slattery Declan McDonogh 15-2 79 88 94 Has enjoyed a good winter campaign here, consistent other than when sixth behind Voice Of Reason in November; won in good style over C&D in February; big efforts over 2m and C&D since; respected again. Sir Callisto 6 9-1t A Martin Robbie Colgan 7-2 77 65 91 Dual C&D winner, including when improving on last month's comeback third behind Beauparc to run out a cosy winner off 72 at the start of the month; 5lb higher now but there's potential for more to come. Wandering Rocks 7 9-0tb1 W Durkan Jamie Orr (7) 20-1 76 - 93 Sole success for this yard came in Ballinrobe maiden hurdle in 2024; fine effort at big odds over C&D after long layoff in January when fourth to Voice Of Reason but unable to back that up in two subsequent starts; new headgear. Liberate 4 8-12 D Hogan Jamie Powell 66-1 74 - 92 Second runner for yard; won 1m2f Goodwood novice last year but safely held afterwards in handicaps for James Horton; bought for 5,000gns in December; never a factor behind Sir Callisto on C&D stable debut; will need more time. Rock Of Ireland 5 8-12 R Anthony Devine Luke McAteer 5-1 74 72 93 Off the mark over this trip at the Curragh on yard debut last month under a positive ride in testing conditions by a diminishing margin; good effort at Gowran from 7lb higher a fortnight ago when runner-up (well-backed); not certain to replicate that form on AW. La Dame Blanche 7 8-8h D Kilmartin Rory Mulligan (5) 33-1 70 - 92 Three-time Flat winner during her time with two previous trainers; weak overall form in handicaps for this stable; satisfactory hurdles runs late last year; hard to fancy on second AW start (tailed off only other try).

Several of these renew rivalries yet again. Beauparc will have her supporters with Colin Keane back aboard, while Drucker and Sir Callisto remain closely matched with Ger Keane's mare. The vote goes to veteran campaigner SAN ANDREAS, whose Lingfield run can be forgiven and he will be seen to much better effect back at his beloved track. [Adrian Wall] Page 6 spotlightdundalk 23.04.26

1m21/2f(AW) For 4yo+ rated 0-60 Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€5,900 2nd £€1,900 3rd £€900 4th £€400 5th £€200 6th £€100 STAND Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Electric Beauty 4 10-2 M Mulvany Wesley Joyce (3) 10-1 58 - 61 Won her third race on turf when taking 1m Curragh handicap (heavy) in March before a close second there next time; disappointing favourite at Gowran on latest; 0-7 on AW but has run well on the surface and has to be taken seriously from 19lb lower AW mark. Yup Bro 4 10-1p1 J McConnell Rory Cleary 12-1 57 - 61 Lightly-raced 4yo made mildly encouraging handicap debut over C&D in November but beaten out of sight when well-backed favourite here when upped to 1m4f the following month; clearly much better was expected so cheekpieces may help and stable among the winners. Eastern Wind 7 10-0p T McCourt Sadhbh Tormey (7) 25-1 56 - 60 Five-time Flat winner (0-8 on AW) and 1-6 over hurdles; decent return from a break when fifth over C&D last month but finished last over hurdles at Bellewstown five days ago. Ferrari Desert 6 10-0h M Fahey Joseph Harnett (7) 16-1 56 - 61 Sole win came here over 7f in October 2024 and twice second here over 1m in opening months of 2025; no worthwhile form yet this year and has never raced beyond the mile; others preferred. Fine Print 5 10-0t J McConnell Donagh O'Connor 25-1 56 - 63 Second runner for yard; won twice at Wolverhampton a year ago (1m6f/2m); didn't pull up any trees over hurdles last year; looked in need of the run when down the field here (1m4f) this month; market can separate yard's runners. Jawhary 8 9-13v A McGuinness Adam Caffrey 7-4 55 52 60 Dual course winner (1m4f) during the winter; beaten only 1.5l over C&D off 54 last month before runner-up here over 1m4f on latest; looks sure to give his running once again; shortlisted. Doctor Grace 6 9-11p A McGuinness Sam Coen (5) 7-1 53 63 58 Second runner for yard; has won here and regularly placed; however, recent efforts have been below-par and was behind Jawhary last time; others have stronger credentials. If Dora Could 4 9-8t1 D Kilmartin Rory Mulligan (5) 16-1 50 - 62 Not too much to take from three maiden runs on turf last year before staying on into midfield in C&D handicap in August; ran no race at Navan in October; tongue-tied ahead of return; others hold more solid claims. Barretstown 8 9-7 C O'Dwyer Jack Cleary (5) 12-1 49 - 62 Four-time course winner (three over C&D) with his last win coming in September off 1lb higher; best of four 2026 runs came over C&D last month when beaten 0.75l into third; below best two weeks later; player at his best. Copper Craft 4 9-5 A Oliver W J Lee 100-30 47 - 61 Improved for fitting of headgear here over 1m last year (left off now), third of 14 in September after making good headway from off the pace and again rattled home well to dead-heat for fourth in December; should relish the step up in trip on his return. Lady Luck 4 9-2t R Sweeney Seamie Heffernan 33-1 44 - 59 Moderate efforts in handicaps to date although had an excuse here over 1m4f when last seen as was 12lb wrong; nonetheless, remains hard to fancy. Tara Power 8 8-12t K Clarke Gavin Ryan 20-1 40 - 62 Turf record is poor (0-26) but more effective on AW (2-25); this year's form hasn't offered much but is 8lb below last winning mark so can't be totally discounted.

The one to beat is without doubt Jawhary who has been a model of consistency here in recent months. Copper Craft looks set to relish the step up in trip, while Barretstown is a big player if he can bounce back from his latest poor showing. It's difficult to get away from the chances of ELECTRIC BEAUTY, who is much better on turf but can race from a 19lb lower mark back on the all-weather. Tara Power could outrun his odds. [Adrian Wall] Page 7
